items.stem: An AI cash-flow forecast should be used by treasury as:

options.text: A probabilistic estimate with an error band, validated against actuals
options.rationale: Correct: forecasts carry uncertainty and must be backtested.

options.text: A guaranteed figure that needs no checking
options.rationale: Forecasts are uncertain and require validation.

options.text: A reason to stop monitoring cash
A replacement for all treasury judgement

items.explanation: Correct: forecasts carry uncertainty and must be backtested.

items.stem: Which TWO controls should surround AI-based payment-anomaly detection? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Human approval before any flagged payment is released or blocked
options.rationale: Correct: a human control preserves segregation of duties.

options.text: An audit trail of flags and decisions
options.rationale: Correct: traceability supports audit and accountability.

options.text: Letting the model release payments autonomously

options.rationale: Removing logs destroys the audit trail.

items.explanation: Correct: a human control preserves segregation of duties.

items.stem: Managing cash to a single AI forecast without scenarios is risky because it:

options.text: Ignores the range of plausible outcomes and leaves no buffer plan
options.rationale: Correct: scenarios and stress views protect against forecast error.

options.text: Is always more accurate than scenario analysis
options.rationale: A single point estimate is not more reliable than a scenario range.

options.text: Eliminates the need for a liquidity buffer
options.rationale: Buffers are still needed given uncertainty.

options.text: Guarantees the forecast will be met

items.explanation: Correct: scenarios and stress views protect against forecast error.
